notes.title: 1.0.1 Micro Update
notes.notes:
Hey All

We've made a quick little update that removes the Medieval scene at the end when you go to try and save Tommy.

We had it there as a teaser for a future level, but from watching the YouTube vids and listening to feedback, it doesn't make sense. We are going to bring you more story, maps, guns and dinos! Just watch this space, as they'll come a bit at a time in updates and DLC.

Thank You All for Playing and we're so glad you're enjoying it. We're also on Facebook and Twitter if you wanna drop us a comment outside of Steam!
